nodes.description: Mapping of user addresses to token balances, written by constructor, transfer and transferFrom and read by balanceOf.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount, written by approve and read by transferFrom.
Fixed public total supply of 10000 * 10**18 assigned to the deployer in the constructor.
Public token name string 'Nila Token'.
Token symbol string 'NLT'.
Public decimals value, 18.
Deployment constructor that credits totalSupply to msg.sender in the balances mapping.
View function returning balances[user]; reads the balances state variable.
Transfers value tokens from msg.sender to 'to' after a balance requirement check; mutates balances twice.
Transfers value tokens from 'from' to 'to' using msg.sender's allowance; mutates balances twice.
Sets allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value and emits Approval; no allowance decrement on transferFrom.
Caller-controlled address used as balance owner, allowance owner and transfer source; attacker-controllable.
Parameter of balanceOf used as the lookup key into the balances mapping.
Parameter of transfer: destination address credited in the balances mapping.
Parameter of transfer: amount checked against balance and moved between accounts.
Parameter of transferFrom: source address whose balance and allowance are checked.
Parameter of approve: address granted allowance by msg.sender.
Arithmetic addition crediting the recipient balance in transfer; overflow/underflow-checked only by compiler version.
Arithmetic subtraction debiting msg.sender in transfer; unchecked reliance on prior require.
Arithmetic addition crediting the recipient balance in transferFrom.
Arithmetic subtraction debiting 'from' in transferFrom; allowance is never decremented.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the recipient credited with totalSupply during construction.
totalSupply value flows into the constructor balance assignment.
balanceOf returns balances[user], so the user parameter flows into a state read.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer checks balanceOf(msg.sender) and debits msg.sender; caller controls the amount transferable.
The value parameter is added to balances[to] in transfer.
The 'to' parameter indexes the balances mapping written in transfer.
The value parameter is subtracted from balances[msg.sender] in transfer.
transfer writes the balances state mapping.
Execution of transfer reaches the credit addition.
Execution of transfer reaches the debit subtraction.
msg.sender indexes allowance[from][msg.sender] and is the spender approved by transferFrom.
transferFrom spends another account's funds based on the caller-supplied from address and its allowance.
The value parameter is added to balances[to] in transferFrom.
The 'to' parameter indexes the balances mapping written in transferFrom.
The value parameter is subtracted from balances[from] in transferFrom.
The 'from' parameter indexes the balances mapping debited in transferFrom.
transferFrom writes the balances state mapping.
transferFrom reads allowance[from][msg.sender] without ever decrementing it.
Execution of transferFrom reaches the credit addition.
Execution of transferFrom reaches the debit subtraction.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][spender], so msg.sender is the allowance owner.
The spender parameter indexes the allowance mapping written by approve.
The value parameter is stored as the approved allowance.
approve writes the allowance state mapping.
The constructor initializes the balances state mapping.
Placeholder self-reference removed at normalization; msg.sender is the externally controlled entry point for every state-changing function.

normalization_plan.reason: The user parameter is only a lookup key for balances inside balanceOf and carries no independent identity.
The 'to' parameter is only a destination index for the balances write inside transfer.
The 'value' parameter only parameterizes the arithmetic operations guarded by the balance require in transfer.
The 'from' parameter is only a source index for the balance and allowance checks in transferFrom.
The spender parameter is only an index for the allowance mapping write inside approve.
